def run(_context):
    import json
    tools = mb.list_library_tools(contains="TIW")
    t_face = mb.add_tool(tools[25]["library_url"], tools[25]["index"])["document_tool_index"]   # 3/4" HSS 4Fl flat
    t_pock = mb.add_tool(tools[28]["library_url"], tools[28]["index"])["document_tool_index"]   # 3/8" 3Fl Carb ZrN
    t_side = mb.add_tool(tools[61]["library_url"], tools[61]["index"])["document_tool_index"]   # 1/2" HSS 2Fl long
    print("tools:", t_face, t_pock, t_side)

    res = mb.add_operation("Setup1", strategy="face", tool=t_face, name="Face_Top")
    print(json.dumps({k: v["expression"] for k, v in res["params"].items()}, indent=1))
